Stop weighing yourself. How do your clothes fit? How do you look unclothed in the mirror? Scales tell nothing but how much you weigh.

Be patient. Losing 50 pounds of fat might take as much as a year. But,

## Snacks

A snack at mid-morning, mid-af ternoon; and late evening will keep any hunger Six small meals are always much better than the three regular ones we are accustomed to. away

## Meats

Choose one: fish, chicken; turkey or beef once a day Not all four

## Exercise

Regular exercise is absolutely necessary A rule of thumb for fat loss: about 80% from diet and 20% from exercise. Both are essential.

## Balance

When you attain your desired body proportions (not just weight) , relax bit down to the Rule of 80/20. Eat in moderation about 80 percent of the time, and enjoy what you like to eat (again; reasonably) the other 20 percent of the time. You don't have to give up the pleasures of foods you really like.

## Moderate

Self-discipline is the key to attaining and keeping your optimum body fat all your life.
